title: Res. Bangka en onderh – blad 33/XXIII m

series.title: Res. Bangka en onderh.
series.notes: Map series of Bangka Island, off Sumatra, Indonesia, showing administrative boundaries, transportation, ground and water features, vegetation, cultivation, religious sites, kampongs and buildings. Relief shown by contours, hachures and spot heights. | Map in Dutch. | At top of maps: Fotogrammetrische kaarteering or Topografische en fotogrammetrische kaarteering. | Each sheet has individual number. | Includes sheet index, boundary diagram, glossary and compilation note.

creator: Dutch East Indies. Topografische Dienst.
